purpose: exclude every P3 diagnostic turn and family from the P5 fit, validation and test partitions and from every M-budget selection; excluded rows are NOT removed from the corpus (stage_build.py arm-order p5_exclusion note)
reserved_prefix_rule: any corpus turn_id or family_id starting with a reserved prefix is excluded, for every window, present and future
excluded_turn_ids_note: the capture ids actually used; corpus turn_id == capture_id (latent_worker.py:389 capture.submit passes record.descriptor.capture_id as turn_id); filled by the driver from turns.jsonl at window close
excluded_family_ids_note: corpus family_id == source_session_id (latent_worker.py:389 passes source_session_id as family_id); one source session covers all three P3 captures, so the whole P3 diagnostic corpus presence is one family

other_diagnostic_namespaces.p7-: semantic-phase references (P/W/S/N/N0/T/F) if later enrolled; register the prefix here before any P7 session is enrolled

application.where: P5 partition construction, BEFORE calibration_corpus.split_manifest; exclusion is family-atomic and deterministic in turn ids and families alone
application.rule: drop every corpus turn whose turn_id is in excluded_turn_ids, or starts with any reserved_prefix, or whose family_id is in excluded_family_ids or starts with any reserved_prefix; then split the remainder
must_hold: no excluded turn appears in the FIT, VALIDATION or TEST partition
no excluded turn contributes rows to any M-budget selection (budgets are computed over FIT only, calibration_collector.py write())
the exclusion decision is recorded with the excluded-set sha256 in the P5 report
excluded rows stay in the corpus files; nothing is deleted or rewritten

defense_in_depth: P3 captures use span policy v1 (whole_completed_response_tail_v1); the calibration handoff runs only when prepared[span_selection] exists, which only a v2 policy builds (latent_worker.py:367; plan 2.3 consequence), so P3 turns should never enter the corpus at all
the exclusion list is the mandatory second line of defence required by stage_build.py's arm-order document
audit rule for P5: any corpus turn with span_policy whole_completed_response_tail_v1 is reported (P4 collection uses v2 content spans)
